target.purpose: Detect refusal-policy regressions with structured reason semantics, mutation-stable golden cases, and deterministic cross-version behavioral diffs.
target.central_bottleneck: A protected refusal can degrade through allow conversion, reason drift, category drift, or mutation sensitivity while a flat string-only golden test reports too little about the regression.

invariants: protected golden refusals cannot silently become allows
reason codes map through an explicit versioned taxonomy
unknown reason categories do not count as successful golden semantics
only cases marked mutation-stable are fuzzed for same-reason preservation
mutation fuzz is bounded and deterministic
cross-version comparison explicitly classifies refusal loss and semantic drift
nonclaims: reference safety-regression harness, not a production model policy service
mutation fuzz is bounded rather than exhaustive
the harness does not execute tools or independently prove production model behavior
